description: Follow a CarlNotes topic for the connected account, or unfollow it. Following puts the topic in the account's feed and its list. An owner always follows their own topic. Use it when the user asks Carl or CarlNotes to follow a topic, with phrases like follow this topic or unfollow this topic.

topic_id.description: The topic's id. Optional on a topic-bound server, which already knows its topic.

name: follow_topic
title: Follow a topic
